answer: Stop Sybils with orchard-row tending: each identity is assigned one row in a shared orchard and must finish a chain of state-dependent chores — prune, water, inspect — where every step's input depends on the previous step's output plus a live weather reading, so nothing can be precomputed or parallelized. A juniper hedge marks the row's edge: the agent must report its exact juniper count mid-chain, proving real attention. Claims dock at a wharf with one berth per identity, so a farm of 500 pays 500 sequential real-time chains of 20 minutes each, while one honest agent pays a single chain.
